title: Subgradient Methods on Manifolds with Lower Bounded Curvature
summary: The subgradient method is a classical and foundational approach in non-smooth convex optimization; its simplicity, robustness, and role as a conceptual and algorithmic starting point have made it the backbone of many significant optimization algorithms. Motivated by classical Euclidean results and recent advances in first-order Riemannian optimization, we study the convergence of the subgradient method on Hadamard manifolds with lower bounded curvature.
